## All Posts

```{=html}
<div class="auto-post-filter-bar">
  <button id="toggle-auto-posts" class="btn btn-sm">Hide Automated Posts</button>
</div>
<script>
(function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('toggle-auto-posts');
  if (!btn) return;
  var hiding = false;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    hiding = !hiding;
    var list = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-post-listing'];
    if (!list) return;
    if (hiding) {
      list.filter(function(item) {
        var cats = item.values()['listing-categories'] || '';
        return cats.indexOf('Automated Updates') === -1;
      });
      btn.textContent = 'Show Automated Posts';
    } else {
      list.filter();
      btn.textContent = 'Hide Automated Posts';
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
